label: final copy step of length-3 sequences (plus weak late-copy firing in long sequences)
explanation: Active only in the copy phase, never on original tokens or <DEL>. The strongest and most reliable firing is at the last step of L=3 sequences (t=5, input = orig(1), outputting orig(2)): the predicate is ~99% precise and holds ~53% of activation mass and almost all of the top quartile (73%). Magnitude there is modulated by the input token (v, u, d, b highest) and by first token c/q. The remaining ~47% of mass is weak, diffuse firing on the last 1-3 copy steps of long sequences (L>=6; to_go<=1 holds ~89% of total mass), preferring inputs v, r, i, d, l, h, but only ~5% of such steps fire and no simple token rule captures it. Almost silent for L=4-5 and on early copy steps.
